name: Love Root Zero KissKiss☆Labyrinth
original_name: ラブルートゼロ kisskiss☆ラビリンス
source:
Inspired by a Manga Walker series.

The story begins when the protagonist rejects the confession of a classmate and they are transported to the labyrinth where the failed feelings of love go. There they meet two fairy's and some other students and they realize they have to fight 'Zero' the monster of rejected love in order to be able to escape the labyrinth.
translation:
改編自Manga Walker連載漫畫。

故事始於主角拒絕同班同學的告白。兩人隨後被傳送到一座迷宮，所有無果而終的戀情都會來到這裡。他們在迷宮中遇見兩名妖精和其他學生，並逐漸意識到，只有打倒名為「Zero」的失戀怪物，眾人才能逃離此地。
